characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to the following units: **^^Kabalite Warriors^^**, **^^Incubi^^**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has a 3+ invulnerable save. You cannot re-roll invulnerable saving throws made for this model. The first time an invulnerable saving throw made for this model is failed, until the end of the battle, this model has no invulnerable save.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly Drukhari unit is within 6" of this model, that unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1, and while wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, select one Combat Drug from the Combat Drugs list. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Drug is active for this model's unit (in addition to any active for your army), and each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model would lose its last wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, this model is not destroyed and instead has its remaining Wounds set to 1. This ability cannot trigger more than once per battle.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to the following units: **^^Hellions^^**, **^^Reavers^^**, **^^Scourges with Heavy Weapons^^**, **^^Scourges with Shardcarbines^^**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. You cannot re-roll invulnerable saving throws made for this model. The first time an invulnerable saving throw made for this model is failed, until the end of the battle, this model has no invulnerable save.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and any unit it leads can declare a Fall Back move in any of your Movement phases and still shoot, charge, or fight that turn (as if it had not Fallen Back).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model is part of a unit of Hellions, the unit gains the [LONE OPERATIVE] ability while at full strength (10 or more models). On a turn this model finished a Charge move, attacks made by Hellglaive gain +1 to the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly Hellions unit is within 6" of this model, that unit re-rolls Charge rolls and gains +1 to its Move characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, select two Combat Drugs from the Combat Drugs list. Until the start of your next Command phase, those Combat Drugs are active for this model's unit (in addition to any active for your army).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, on an unmodified Wound roll of 5+, the target suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to normal damage.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly **^^Kabalite Warriors^^** unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to the following units: **^^Mandrakes^^**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. Each time a ranged attack targets this model, if the attacking model is more than 12" away, an unmodified Hit roll of 1-3 fails.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character in the Fight phase, until the end of the battle the Attacks characteristic of Decapitating Blade is increased by 1 (cumulative; up to a maximum of +5 from this ability).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models and terrain features as if they were not there.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly **^^Mandrakes^^** unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability, and each time an attack with the **[PSYCHIC]** ability targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

characteristics.$text: This model has a transport capacity of 10 **^^Drukhari Infantry^^** models (excluding **^^Jump Pack^^** models). Units embarked within it can disembark even if this model Advanced this turn (but cannot declare a charge that turn).

characteristics.$text: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. You cannot re-roll invulnerable saving throws made for this model. The first time an invulnerable saving throw made for this model is failed, until the end of the battle, this model has no invulnerable save.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly **^^Drukhari^^** unit is within 9" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Asdrubael Vect and Vect on the Dais of Destruction cannot both be included in the same army.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a ranged attack with a Range of 24" or more targets this model, that attack's Range is treated as 6" shorter.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a ranged attack would inflict damage on this model, you may roll one D6: on a 5+ (4+ against attacks with the [BLAST] keyword), that damage is reduced to 0.
